hero.title: A Books library that's finally tidy
hero.sub: BookMeta fills in your books in Emby: titles, authors, summaries, series and covers, read straight from your files. No external service, nothing written to your library.
prob.title: Your books deserve better than a file name
prob.1.p: Out of the box, Emby shows the file name: no summary, no readable author, no series.
prob.2.p: A random image, or nothing at all: hard to find your way around a grid of books.
prob.3.p: Online sources return almost nothing in French, and you may not want to send your reading list over the Internet.
sol.title: Everything comes from your files, nothing leaves home
sol.lead: BookMeta reads the metadata.opf file next to each book (written by Bindery from the BnF) or, failing that, the information embedded in the epub.
sol.meta.p: Title, cleaned summary, publication date, publisher, subjects and identifiers (ISBN, BNF).
sol.auth.p: Authors and series can be browsed as tags, and sorting follows Author, Series then Title.
sol.cover.p: Folder image, epub cover, or the first image of a cbz file.
sol.safe.p: No file created, changed or deleted. A damaged file is noted in the log and never raises an error in Emby.
new.title: New in v1.0.0
new.lead: First official release: everything is available from the first install.
new.cover.p: The "BookMeta Embedded Cover" fetcher turns itself on once per book library. Untick it and it stays off.
new.sort.p: The sort order computed from the OPF survives metadata refreshes.
new.cfg.p: One option to turn cover extraction from the epub on or off.

arch.lead: Emby calls BookMeta during a metadata refresh. The plugin reads local files, in this order.
arch.stack: C# / .NET 6 plugin for Emby Server 4.10.2 (Linux, emby/embyserver image). No network, no database, no web UI beyond a settings page.
dep.title: Install BookMeta
dep.lead: Tested with Emby Server 4.10.2. One file = one book; the folder holds an epub or cbz, and optionally metadata.opf and cover.jpg.
dep.rel.p: Download BookMeta-1.0.0.dll and its .sha256 file, verify it, then copy it as BookMeta.dll into Emby's plugins folder (Docker image: /config/plugins/) and restart Emby.
dep.src.p: Linux, macOS and Windows with the .NET 6 SDK. The script builds dist/BookMeta.dll and runs the tests.
dep.cfg.p: In Library, open the Books library settings and tick BookMeta under "Metadata readers". The cover fetcher turns on automatically. Then run Refresh metadata → Replace all metadata and images.
dep.cfgopt: BookMeta menu: "Extract cover from the epub file" checkbox (on by default), then Save. Keep "Save artwork into media folders" unticked.
faq.title: FAQ and known limits
faq.1.a: Emby 4.10 doesn't display people for a book. BookMeta creates one tag per author, shown in the Keyword tab. There are no Authors or Genres tabs for books.
faq.2.a: The series is a "Série : name" tag and drives sorting. The volume number is not displayed.
faq.3.q: Can I edit the sort order by hand?
faq.3.a: Sorting is locked and rewritten on every refresh: edit it in metadata.opf. The lock stays after uninstalling; unlock the Sort field and refresh the book to undo it.
faq.4.a: A PDF is listed but no cover is extracted. Audiobooks are out of scope.
faq.5.q: Does the plugin write any file?
faq.5.a: No: no .nfo, no image, nothing changed in your folders. "Replace all metadata" does overwrite edits you made by hand in Emby.
